title: The Einstein field equation
summary: The Einstein tensor and its vanishing divergence; the field equation G = 8πG T with the constant fixed by the Newtonian limit; the cosmological constant as a perfect fluid; the Einstein–Hilbert action and the Palatini variation; why GR is the simplest relativistic theory of gravity.

objectives.description: Objectives will be finalised when the unit is prepared; the source material is 8.962 Lectures 12–13 (Lecture Guide page 3), Tong Chapter 4 and Carroll Chapter 4.

preparation.description: Read the Lecture Guide's synopses of Lectures 12 and 13 (PDF page 3): Einstein tensor, field equation and its normalisation, cosmological constant; the variational derivation and the Palatini remark.
Watch Lectures 12 and 13 from the video gallery (transcripts on each lecture page).
Second account: Tong, General Relativity, Chapter 4 The Einstein Equations (reference-only).
Optional: Carroll, Chapter 4 Gravitation (the field equations and the action), reference-only.
